title: Migrate custom browser runtime hosts
goal: Update a hand-written browser loader against its shipped Mono or opt-in CoreCLR package; verify startup lifetime, resource loading and diagnostic provider options for the actual runtime.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Managed export source uses C# 15; host TypeScript is compiled with 5.9.3 against each exact package declaration.
language.name: C#

packages.name: Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Pack
packages.reason: The WebAssembly SDK resolves its matching pack; actual RC2 dependencies are locked and recorded.

packageAssets: Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Pack 11; actual Mono.browser-wasm or browser-wasm runtime assets.

workloads.name: wasm-tools
workloads.reason: Diagnostic-enabled browser native relinking requires the matching .NET 11 WebAssembly and Emscripten toolchain; actual RC2 manifest pins are retained in sample evidence.

prerequisites: Browser with WebAssembly/SIMD/exception handling, HTTP static host, TypeScript compiler, matching .NET WebAssembly SDK and runtime pack.
UseMonoRuntime=false selects the experimental CoreCLR browser route; there is no .NET 10 CoreCLR-browser equivalent.
platforms: Measured Chromium on Windows with .NET 10 Mono and RC2 Mono/CoreCLR; no other-browser/platform/AOT performance claim.
providers: Local EventPipe/EventSource diagnostic providers; no external provider service.
optIns: UseMonoRuntime=false only for the CoreCLR sample.
EnableDiagnostics=true for actual trace collection, with a matching native toolchain.
stabilityLimitations: Measured RC2 artifacts are not GA verification; PIN-959/PIN-962 and existing Human gates remain open.
CoreCLR browser is opt-in preview; custom host APIs have no backwards compatibility guarantee.
constraints: Packaged dotnet.d.ts is authoritative for the measured build; VMR source and Mono/CoreCLR declarations differ.
Browser host declarations explicitly provide no backwards-compatibility guarantee; retest custom hosts after package changes.
Deprecated withConfigSrc/run/environment setter are distinct from removed asset members; retain supported older methods.
